title: Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting
function: Ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this hydrogen hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting and fat life requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction
commonFailures: Irradiation embrittlement in flux >1e18 n/cm2 - mitigated by fine equiaxed alpha (ASTM 8+) microstructure

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting suitable for Ultra-high purity hydrogen tube compression fitting?
faq.a: Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address hydrogen hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. hydrogen hardware components receive Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium UHP Hydrogen Tube Fitting shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for UHP fitting / H2 fitting hydrogen hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
